id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow on the line.

reactive_power_flow.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow on the line.

arc.description: An `Arc` defining this line `from` a bus `to` another bus.

b.description: Shunt susceptance, specified both on the `from` and `to` ends of the line. These are commonly modeled with the same value.

rating.description: Thermal rating. Flow on the line must be between -`rating` and `rating`.

g.description: Shunt conductance, specified both on the `from` and `to` ends of the line. These are commonly modeled with the same value.
